_doc: Per-species extraction fixes, applied by tools/petart/extract.py and copied into PROVENANCE.md. Every entry needs a why; unknown keys are rejected. cells: keys 's<stage>/<bNN|cNN>' or '*/<bNN|cNN>' with any of source (render this file from another cell of the same stage), flip (mirror horizontally), dx/dy (canvas px nudge; dy<0 raises), scale (size multiplier for this cell), fit_exclude (shrink only this cell if it would not fit), grounded (hopper locomotion frame stays on the ground line and out of airborneFrames), erase_src (list of [x0,y0,x1,y1] source-sheet rects, one stage only) with optional erase_when ('g>r+10 && g>b+60'): matching source pixels are repainted with the key colour before keying. sheets: keys 's<stage>/<base|care>' with scale (relative size multiplier for every cell of that sheet, used when the generator drew one sheet of a stage at a different character size than the other), keying options (below) and reassign (list of {near:[x,y], to:cell}: move the detached component nearest that sheet point to another cell). keying: species-wide keying options for all six sheets, overridden per sheet: clear_share, pocket_share, pocket_clear, despill ('band'|'full'), spill_gamut (see keying.key_sheet).
